title: Each tile header shows its name, report icon and blue date pill
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in on the build under test as an Admin user. The Admin role holds every permission, including Reports. To use another role, first check Settings > Roles & Permissions > that role: the Reports permission must be on.
  2. Pick one workplace in the workplace selector at the right of the top bar (e.g. QA Testing).
  3. Use a desktop browser at 100% zoom on a screen at least 1024 pixels wide (any ordinary laptop or desktop monitor).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Look at the header of each of the six tiles, from left to right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Revenue, Billing Efficiency, Technician Efficiency, Technician Utilization and Sales by Customer each show their name, a small square-and-arrow report icon right beside the name, and a blue pill with a calendar icon at the right of the header.
  • At Risk Customers shows its name and a blue pill with a clock icon reading 120 Days, and no report icon.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9584 (Story 12, Visual Conformance); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850 v42, read 7 Oct 2026, Story 12. Re-sourced from the retired 'Dashboard Directions' design to the current design canvas. Also PRD Story 4, Story 5 and Story 10. Design canvas (claude.ai/artifact/Wae9DFQ8PJQBy8mbLsL5ge, screenshots of the SV-8311 build captured 2026-09-28) boards 01_Opens_After, 02_Last12_After (arrow beside the name opens the report), 03_Range_After (each card's range is a blue pill) and 09_AtRisk_Window (the 120 Days pill).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R1: “Each KPI tile shows a label, a headline value, a sparkline, a date-range control, and a report link.”
  • S5-N2: “The At Risk Customers tile does not show a report link, because there is no At Risk report.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
